title: Review & sign
subtitle: Check your listing, read the seller policy, then sign.

summary.heading: 1. Check your listing
summary.description: This is what buyers will see. Tap Edit to change anything.

policy.heading: 2. Read the seller policy
policy.intro: By submitting this listing, I confirm and agree on behalf of my farm:

accurate.title: Accurate livestock information
accurate.text: All details (species, breed, age, colour, state, feed, photos and videos) are truthful and current to the best of my knowledge.

compliance.title: Animal health & Malaysian legal/permit compliance
compliance.text: Animals comply with Malaysian livestock, health, and movement regulations, including required permits and veterinary standards.

pricing.title: Pricing, availability & order responsibility
pricing.text: I set my own prices, keep availability accurate, and am responsible for honouring accepted orders.

delivery.title: Delivery responsibility
delivery.text: I will fulfil delivery per my selected delivery method and ensure safe handover to the buyer.

privacy.title: Buyer privacy, fraud & account enforcement
privacy.text: I will protect buyer information, not engage in fraudulent activity, and understand QURBI may suspend accounts that breach this policy.

sign.heading: 3. Sign & confirm
sign.dateHint: Today's date is filled in. Future dates are not allowed.
sign.agree: I have read and agree to the Seller Policy and confirm all information is accurate.

errorKept: Your details and signature are kept — just try again.

hint.ready: Ready to submit. Buyers will see it once it's published.
